purpose: A notology is an admission discipline for names and claims: it records the frame, translation, depth, verification, closure state, boundary, and next opening of a repository resource. It does not assert a fixed ontology.

claimKinds.mayState: A supplied source, observation, or historical design intention.
claimKinds.mustNotState: The source proposal is true, formally proved, or a recorded learner return.

claimKinds.mayState: An intended learner interaction, workflow, or safety requirement.
claimKinds.mustNotState: The product works, causes the intended effect, or verifies a source claim.

claimKinds.mayState: A carrier, relation, translation, question family, or predicate with declared assumptions.
claimKinds.mustNotState: The carrier or assumptions describe reality without a separate argument.

claimKinds.mayState: What the named Lean source proves under its stated structures and axioms.
claimKinds.mustNotState: An educational, physical, metaphysical, or empirical conclusion beyond that scope.

claimKinds.mayState: A deterministic bounded run or recorded closure-packet state.
claimKinds.mustNotState: Independent review, general-world evidence, or a theorem.

claimKinds.mayState: A disciplined way to read a source or formal structure.
claimKinds.mustNotState: A literal causal, physical, psychological, or metaphysical result.

claimKinds.mayState: A contestable thesis about truth, mind, nature, value, or existence.
claimKinds.mustNotState: A conclusion promoted by source authority, interface behavior, or a bounded formal model.

claimKinds.mayState: An explicit limitation, missing bridge, or open obligation.
claimKinds.mustNotState: A closed answer merely because the limitation has been named.

depths.meaning: A declared bridge between relative presentations or orientations.
A finite grain, aggregate, zoom, partition, or other selected readout.
Every member of a declared refinement family; not an unstated universal semantics.
Source, attempt, counter-reading, comparison, review, receipt, and successor obligations.

closureStates.meaning: A question, claim, or relation is named but has no complete executable packet.
A source-grounded relation and reciprocal bridge are declared; no reviewed return is implied.
An executed reciprocal path awaits comparison; no return is yet recorded.
A reviewed receipt and changed successor are recorded; its remaining difference starts a next opening.
The resource is a formal, editorial, or interpretive claim rather than a learner-packet state.

addresses.name: Speed Learn / Universe-Perspective Path source
addresses.translation: The source's perspective → WHY → goal → learning → return grammar enters the packet protocol without becoming a theorem.
addresses.boundary: A direct design source does not prove its educational, physical, or metaphysical proposals.
addresses.nextOpening: Supply a source-grounded learner episode with an attempt, counter-reading, comparison, review, receipt, and successor.

addresses.name: Perspectival-curvature source packet
addresses.translation: Perspective → WHY → goal and its reciprocal re-reading are declared in the packet witness language.
addresses.boundary: The packet has no material, attempt, counter-reading, comparison method, review, receipt, or successor.
addresses.nextOpening: Execute and review a concrete closure episode rather than promoting the PATH state.

addresses.name: Perspective / belief-value / WHY / goal / lesson-project-world map
addresses.translation: Zoom and recentering expose opposite orientations of one learner relation, not independent navigation mechanics.
addresses.boundary: The design is not an efficacy result and does not constitute a runtime closure by itself.
addresses.nextOpening: Connect a real learner packet to a recorded, reviewable map projection.

addresses.name: Answer-preserving translation, orbit closure, and natural-choice adapter
addresses.translation: For a supplied orbit-separating answer family, closure relation, true translation, and natural choice coincide in the formal frame.
addresses.boundary: It does not select the questions, prove their real-world exhaustiveness, or elevate natural choice into a moral or physical fact.
addresses.nextOpening: Provide and independently assess a warranted question family for a particular source-grounded episode.

addresses.name: Completion in translational truth equality
addresses.translation: Within its supplied answer language, completability depends on translated truth answers rather than local/global basis, trajectory sign, or endpoint markers.
addresses.boundary: The finite question language, translations, and answer functions are supplied; no real contact relation or universal semantics is selected.
addresses.nextOpening: State and test a warranted question language before applying the marker-blind completion relation beyond the model.

addresses.name: Finite partition aggregate and successor distinction
addresses.translation: Two four-form presentations agree at a scalar language, while a supplied retained-phase question separates them at a successor language.
addresses.boundary: It is a finite integer-coordinate model, not a continuous wave, cosmological, or learner-validity result.
addresses.nextOpening: Specify a warranted successor discriminator or a separately stated continuous model.

addresses.name: Local-stage and internal-truth boundary models
addresses.translation: Toy diagonal, stage-tower, liar, and capacity structures distinguish a local level from a selected limit theory and an internal-truth obstruction.
addresses.boundary: The model does not formalize, refute, or bypass Gödel, Tarski, Chaitin, arbitrary computation, or a final global truth language.
addresses.nextOpening: State an independently motivated formal language and relation before making a metamathematical application.

addresses.name: Ledger-derived perspectival closure hull
addresses.translation: The projector maps a declared packet to a prospective branch and OPEN remainder without inventing an experience fibre or returned basis.
addresses.boundary: A deterministic projection cannot perform external review or establish a human learning transformation.
addresses.nextOpening: Add only a receipt-complete packet before projecting a returned experience or successor state.

addresses.name: Natural-rhythm triangle as a perspective/goal closure reading
addresses.translation: The downward and upward passes read prospective and returned orientations of a maintained relation.
addresses.boundary: It does not establish a physical light cone, universal harmony, natural law, or a privileged learner trajectory.
addresses.nextOpening: Connect the reading to an explicit packet and separately justify any mathematical or empirical extension.

addresses.name: Source, formal, runtime, and interpretation separation
addresses.translation: A claim may change presentation across source, formal, runtime, and interpretive surfaces only with its claim kind and boundary preserved.
addresses.boundary: Classification itself does not establish the truth, adequacy, or social value of a claim.
addresses.nextOpening: Attach each new repository resource to a checked relative closure address.
